verdict.rationale: The CLI/SDK/REST API give full programmatic control (search offers, create instances, manage endpoints, keys) with scriptable syntax usable in shell/Python loops, and scoped API keys are explicitly recommended for CI/CD and shared tooling — enabling scripted bulk operations across many resources. However, there is no explicit documented example of a batch/bulk command (e.g., launching or terminating many instances in one call) or dedicated bulk-operations feature. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk/batch API endpoint or CLI flag, hands-on evidence of bulk usage, and independent corroboration beyond docs.
